messages:
Maria Chen: FYI starting a short thread: aligning SI co-sell handoffs when leads come from cloud marketplaces or hardware referral programs. Need simple, enforceable rules.
Samir Shah: thanks  biggest friction we saw was duplicate claims + delayed responses from partners. propose 72h claim window for marketplace leads (longer cycle) and 48h for hardware partner referrals.
Olivia Park: 72h sounds okay for marketplace. Suggest we require partner to log an initial activity within 12h (email or meeting scheduled) else claim becomes provisional.
Maria Chen: good call. so provisional -> becomes abandoned if no activity in 12h; final claim expires after 72h. We'll surface this in CRM with `claim_status` = provisional/final/abandoned.
Leila Gomez: about lead ownership conflicts: rule of engagement = first-claim wins, but allow Sales Ops override for strategic accounts. Override must include reason + approver.
Dana Brooks: define strategic: top-territory customers or ARR>750k. Also, for hardware partners we should allow co-ownership tag so SI + partner can both be assigned for enablement.
Samir Shah: for dedupe, we'll canonicalize domains and map marketplace account_id -> CRM external_id. Script: `scripts/dedupe_marketplace.py --source marketplace --batch 500`.
Olivia Park: ops question: how do we audit partner activity to prevent claim hoarding?
Maria Chen: track metrics: claim_acceptance_rate, abandoned_claim_rate, avg_time_to_first_activity. Ops dashboard needs daily feed.
Leila Gomez: legal ask re: co-listings in marketplace: need a signed partner addendum before we enable co-marketing. No exceptions for public listings.
Dana Brooks: add a quick adjudication flow for ties: ops opens a short intake form with evidence from both partners; product-marketing + partnerships adjudicate within 24h.
Samir Shah: sample adjudication payload: ```POST /api/partner-claims/resolve { "lead_id":"mp-9987", "claims":[ {"partner":"SI-Forge","score":85},{"partner":"EdgeWorks","score":84} ], "evidence":"meeting-notes+demo-recording" }```
Olivia Park: I'll add the 12h/48h/72h windows and the co-ownership flag to the CRM mapping spreadsheet. Sharing link in a sec.
deploy-bot: New doc created: https://confluence.redwood.company/partnerships/marketplace-handoff-playbook (draft)
Maria Chen: action items: Olivia - update CRM mapping + sheet, Samir - run dedupe script on last 90 days, Dana - draft co-ownership badge copy for marketplace listing, Leila - confirm legal addendum template. Aim: pilot next Tues.
Samir Shah: running dedupe this afternoon, will post errors to the doc.
Olivia Park: uploaded sheet: https://docs.redwood.company/partnerships/marketplace-crm-mapping (edit rights for partnerships).
Leila Gomez: legal will prepare addendum template and share comments by EOD Mon.
Maria Chen: thanks team. We'll keep this short and iterate after pilot. :rocket:
